crude_monthly.title: Crude imports and price
crude_monthly.description: Monthly crude oil imports (MOF customs, via PAJ table 03) in mb/d, CIF unit value in $/bbl, yen per dollar, and fuel product output (PAJ table 02) in kb/d, Jan 2024 – Aug 2026.

crude_origin_aug2026.title: Crude imports by country, Aug 2026
crude_origin_aug2026.description: Japan crude imports by country in August 2026 (METI, via Arab News Japan), converted to kb/d, with each country's typical export crude quality (indicative; not reported in trade data).

crude_origin_monthly.title: Crude imports by origin, monthly
crude_origin_monthly.description: Japan crude imports April–August 2026 (total and from the US, kb/d) and Middle East share, from METI data as reported in the press; 2025 baseline from Platts. Each row names its source.

exports_monthly.title: Product exports by month
exports_monthly.description: Monthly exports of gasoil, gasoline, jet fuel and fuel oil B/C in kb/d (PAJ table 02), Jan 2025 – Aug 2026.

grade_slate.title: Yields at a cracking refinery
grade_slate.description: Indicative product yields, % of crude by weight, for WTI Light, Arab Light (Upper Zakum stand-in), Murban and Oman at a cracking-type refinery (crude unit, vacuum unit, FCC, no coker), from the crude yield model built on TotalEnergies and ExxonMobil assays.

headline.title: Headline figures
headline.description: Key 2026 figures computed from PAJ tables 02, 03 and 05: crude import low and price peak, government reserve draw, sales change, end-August stocks and net product trade.

mix_check.title: Product mix: model vs PAJ
mix_check.description: Share of refinery output by product group. Model: cracking-type yields for an assumed 2025 slate (Middle East split evenly between Arab Light and Murban types, 4.5% WTI) and the August 2026 METI slate (Saudi, Kuwait, Qatar as Arab Light; UAE as Murban; US as WTI; others as Oman). Actual: PAJ refinery production, May–August 2025 and 2026, by volume.

net_trade.title: Net product trade
net_trade.description: Average product imports, exports and net trade in kb/d for Jan–Aug 2026, with net trade for Jan–Aug 2025 (PAJ table 02).

range_long.title: Monthly series 2021–2026
range_long.description: Monthly values for 2021 to the latest 2026 month: crude imports, CIF price and yen rate (MOF via PAJ table 03), stockpile days (PAJ table 05), and production, domestic sales, imports, exports (kb/d) and inventories (million kl) by product (PAJ table 02).

refinery_config.title: Refinery unit capacities
refinery_config.description: Published unit capacities (b/d) for Idemitsu Aichi, Hokkaido and Chiba (as of April 2026) and Taiyo Oil Shikoku (as of November 2022), from the operators' websites, with conversion and residue desulfurization as a share of crude distillation.

refining_capacity.title: Refining capacity by refinery
refining_capacity.description: Designed crude capacity of Japan's 19 refineries at end April 2026 in b/d (PAJ table 04); group by parent company is Claude's classification.

sales_change.title: Fuel sales change by product
sales_change.description: Change in domestic sales by product: FY2016 to FY2025, and Apr–Aug 2026 against Apr–Aug 2025 (PAJ table 02), with FY2025 volume in kb/d.

stockpile_days.title: Oil stockpiles by holder
stockpile_days.description: End-month oil stockpiles in days of consumption held by government, private companies and producer joint storage (PAJ table 05), Jan 2025 – Jul 2026.

stocks_august.title: End-August product stocks
stocks_august.description: Commercial product inventories at the end of August, 2017–2026, million kl (PAJ table 02).
